hooks.command: input=$(cat); branch=$(git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD 2>/dev/null); if [ "$branch" != "main" ] && [ "$branch" != "master" ]; then exit 0; fi; if [ "$CHIMERA_ALLOW_MAIN" = "1" ]; then exit 0; fi; file=$(printf '%s' "$input" | python3 -c 'import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); ti=d.get("tool_input",{}); print(ti.get("file_path") or ti.get("notebook_path") or "")'); case "$file" in *.md|*/docs/*) exit 0;; esac; case "$(basename "$file")" in CHANGELOG*|README*|LICENSE*|.gitignore|.gitattributes|.editorconfig) exit 0;; esac; echo "[chimera] Refusing to Edit/Write '$file' on '$branch' — create a feature branch (git checkout -b feat/...) or set CHIMERA_ALLOW_MAIN=1 for chores. Docs (*.md, docs/**, CHANGELOG/README/LICENSE/.gitignore/.gitattributes/.editorconfig) auto-pass." >&2; exit 2
